'Salia sahi', the largest slum in Bhubaneswar, and Ishaneswar Basti in Bhubaneswar were included in the pilot. The pilot areas are representative of EWS, LIG, MIG, HIG and other groups. The earlier notification in WATCO-16 extends the PIYUSH scheme, which gives water connections to BPL households, to Antyodaya and Annapurna households. That notification also lets non-owners apply with an indemnity bond. Together these are specific affordability and access measures, so Part A would fit the 2.5 band. Part B. The only women-related item is the Jalasathi programme. Jalasathis are women SHG members who facilitate connections, read meters, bill and collect charges. That is a community-partnership and livelihood role.
